Gideon, you first reported the kiosks offline at **10:42 AM on 3 Aug** in this channel. Your message says both inbound lanes were showing a white screen after badge scans, and the guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard.

The channel has no other record of the guard's activity. Mateo's 11:03 AM message says kiosk 1 was back and the guard checked in trailer 8836, which dispatch could see. Your 11:08 AM message says both lanes were working as of 11:07.
